title: Core note ASK_REVIEW (quiet_review): a question held for the working morning — an urgent one that cannot wait is asked again starting with 🚨 and the held card is withdrawn; an ordinary one stays: no 🚨, no withdraw, no second ask
note: PR #553: when the owner's non-working hours hold a card, the answer to the session's AskUserQuestion carries ASK_REVIEW after ASK_DETACHED. The system prompt is the hub skill + the core's addendum, the same for both versions; the core's words are the constants of each version (⟦KEY⟧; a version without ASK_REVIEW gets an empty line — the baseline, which has no such note). Run with --before <main before the change> --trials 8 and --only before|after in two processes. urgent: customers get errors from prod now — the session asks again with 🚨 (AskUserQuestion) and runs `hub question withdraw q41`; ordinary: a naming question — nothing is asked again, nothing withdrawn, no 🚨. The `before` of urgent is 0/8 by construction (the text that names the way is the change); the owner's decision for the urgent case is the thing to read, and the ordinary case is the regression: the note must not make sessions mark everything 🚨. Names and texts are made up.
